headline: LyondellBasell Industries (LYB) Rebounds In Q2, Is It Still A Bargain?
summary: LyondellBasell Industries (NYSE:LYB) reported second quarter 2026 results with revenue of US$9.18b and net income of US$558m, reflecting stronger margins supported by tighter petrochemical markets and portfolio and cost initiatives.
